input.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Cosy music for a grand old country-house library at night, the home base of a cheerful adventure game. A gentle, curious harpsichord melody over a warm string quartet, soft clarinet and flute phrases, plucked double bass, with a quiet crackling fireplace ambience underneath. Relaxed, homely, a little regal and inquisitive, about 92 BPM, steady even dynamics, no big crescendo and no ending, designed to loop seamlessly as background music.
